item.title: Gunkanjima (Battleship Island) — Guide
item.description: Gunkanjima, officially Hashima, is a small abandoned island off Nagasaki whose silhouette of dense high-rise ruins resembles a battleship — hence its nickname. From the 1880s it was a coal-mining island, and to house the thousands of miners and their families, some of Japan’s first large reinforced-concrete apartment blocks were packed onto its tiny surface, making it at its peak in the 1950s the most densely populated place on Earth. When the mine closed in 1974 everyone left almost overnight, and the island was frozen in time — a ghostly maze of decaying buildings, empty stairwells and shattered windows slowly reclaimed by the sea and weather.
